
# Change Log
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](http://keepachangelog.com/)
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](http://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased] - yyyy-mm-dd

### Added
- [Issue `#24`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/24): Added a Changelog.
- [Issue `#23`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/23): Added Git Hooks with pre-commits.
- [Issue `#06`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/06): Added complete WSL2 support for devs on Windows.
- [Issue `#21`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/21): Added unit and integration tests for the Rust API.

### Changed
- [Issue `#30`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/30): Changed license from MIT to GPL.
- [Issue `#37`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/37), [Issue `#38`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/38), [Issue `#39`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/39), [Issue `#40`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/40): Cleanup.

### Fixed
- [Issue `#19`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/19): Expanded the root README with development, architecture, setup, user, issue-reporting, and repository-link sections.
- [Issue `#31`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/31): Fixed setup script failing when first ran with an error of not being able to connect with DB.
- [Issue `#34`](https://github.com/Abled-Taha/iron_book/issues/34): Fixed Django server showing it is running on port 8000 even though it was running on 8080
